AT&T Internet Air: 5G Wireless Home Internet for $55/mo

AT&T Internet Air®​

Home internet you can count on starting at $55/mo.
Stay connected with unlimited, fast, reliable home internet with no data caps. Over the AT&T 5G wireless network.
Price plus taxes and fees. AutoPay & paperless bill required. Not available in all areas. Set up Internet Air in three simple steps

Once your new equipment is delivered, it’s quick and easy to get started.

Download

Sign in

Create your account and follow the steps for self-setup.

Set up

Scan the QR code on your All-Fi Hub to get connected.
